result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. No critical or major visual defects were found; only a few minor cosmetic and consistency issues are present.

issues.description: Cards in the 'Fastest near you' section show only delivery time and fee, while the 'Popular right now' card (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) additionally shows a star rating and cuisine type, creating inconsistent card metadata across sections.
issues.suggestion: Standardize card metadata (e.g., include rating and cuisine on all restaurant cards) or intentionally document the difference between compact and expanded card variants.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the pizza card near the bottom sits on a dark semi-transparent circle, while the heart on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image appears on a plain dark image without a visible consistent backdrop treatment, making the icon treatment look slightly inconsistent between cards.
issues.suggestion: Use the same scrim/backdrop style for the heart icon on all promotional image cards to ensure consistent visibility and styling.

issues.description: The placeholder text in the search field ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a light gray background, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios for some users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text or lighten the field background to meet WCAG AA contrast guidance for placeholder/hint text.
